kanto.flavorText: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

original-johto.flavorText: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.

hoenn.flavorText: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

updated-johto.flavorText: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.

original-unova.flavorText: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

updated-unova.flavorText: As long as its red core remains, it can regenerate its body instantly, even if it’s torn apart.

kalos.flavorText: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Staryu apparently communicates with the stars in the night sky by flashing the red core at the center of its body. If parts of its body are torn, this Pokémon simply regenerates the missing pieces and limbs.

original-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon gets nibbled on by Lumineon and others. Thanks to its red core, it regenerates fast, so it’s unconcerned by their snack attacks.

updated-alola.flavorText: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.

swsh.flavorText: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.
